Old-format save codes for the step 10 playtest (section F).
These are real old-shaped saves taken from the project's test fixtures. Paste one
into Saves -> Import in the NEW build. Importing replaces your current game, so
export your own code first if you want to keep it.

=== A) OLD v12 FLAT SAVE (no place saved) ===
Expect: loads fine, credits 4850, ships Wasp + Prospector, and you end up DOCKED at
Meridian Station (old saves with no place default to the starting pocket).

arrival point, because that old save was made away from the station.
